name: dubchef
description: Dubchef - thuyết minh tự động đa ngôn ngữ (Việt, Anh, Trung) cho video nấu ăn

scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:server && npm --prefix web test && npm --prefix mobile test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix mobile run lint
scripts.test:ollama:docker: docker compose exec -T api node scripts/test-ollama.mjs
scripts.test:media:docker: docker compose exec -T -e MEDIA_INTEGRATION=true api node --test test/media.integration.test.mjs
